# Carbone template syntax: verified feature matrix (our deployment)

**Target:** `carbone/carbone-ee:full-5.15.3-fonts` (v5.15.3), no license. The startup log says `templating: Basic (Community Edition)` and "Only features of the Community Edition are enabled".
**Method:** Each case is a minimal DOCX template generated by `python3 zipfile`, with one tag per `<w:r><w:t>` run. Each one was rendered the same way as `apps/api/src/modules/carbone/client.ts` renders: `POST /template` with `carbone-version: 5`, then `POST /render/{id}?download=true` with `{data, convertTo, lang, timezone}`. Production passes `lang: 'ru-ru'` (reports/service.ts) and `timezone: 'Europe/Moscow'`. Unless a row says otherwise, all results below use exactly those options. We rendered to DOCX and extracted the text of `word/document.xml`. PDF was spot-checked.
**Raw evidence:** пробы и записанные ответы EE перенесены в `packages/carbone/test/golden/matrix.json`; исходный Python-харнесс (`lib.py`, `runner.js`, `tests*.py`, `results*.txt`) — в `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-09-carbone-embedded/probe-harness/`.

Legend: ✅ works · ⚠️ works with a quirk, or the result is wrong or silently ignored · ❌ disabled in Community, or an error.

How a disabled feature fails: when a template uses a formatter that is disabled in Community, the **whole render fails**. Carbone returns HTTP 500 with `Formatter "X" is disabled in the Community Edition. Source: "{tag}"` (code `w101`). In our API this becomes `CARBONE_ERROR 502 ошибка генерации: …`. Nothing degrades gracefully.

Docs base: `https://carbone.io/documentation/design/…` (abbreviated below as `…/`).

---

## 0. Headline findings (read first)

| # | Finding | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **ALL aggregators are disabled in Community**: `aggSum`, `aggAvg`, `aggMin`, `aggMax`, `aggCount`, `aggCountD`, `aggStr`, `aggStrD`, `cumSum`, `cumCount`, `cumCountD`. **`:count()` is also disabled**, because it is internally rewritten to `cumCount`. | Totals, subtotals and group counts must be computed in the data (SQL/JSON). The docs do not mark aggregators as Enterprise. |
| 2 | **`lang: 'ru-ru'` (what we send) does NOT localize numbers or currency.** `formatN` gives `1,234,567.89`, and `formatC` gives `1,234,567.89 €`. Dates are localized correctly (`08 марта 2026`). With **`lang: 'ru'`** you get `1 234 567,89` and `1 234 567,89 ₽`. `ru-RU` and `ru_RU` behave like `ru-ru`. | Change the API to send `lang: 'ru'` (dates are identical). The translations key must then be `ru` too. |
| 3 | `drop()` / `keep()` (smart conditions) are disabled. `hideBegin/hideEnd` and `showBegin/showEnd` inside table rows **corrupt the table**: a 1-cell residual row is left and cell properties are lost. | Hide rows with **loop filters** `[i, field=value]`. Use `hideBegin/showBegin` only for paragraphs or inline text. |
| 4 | `formatC(n, 'USD')` and `convCurr('USD')` **silently convert using built-in exchange rates**: 1000 RUB becomes 14,68 $ and 1000 EUR becomes 1 140,30 $. Your own rates apply only when you pass `currencySource`, `currencyTarget` and `currencyRates` in the render body. The body key `currency: {…}` is ignored. | Never pass a target currency in templates unless rates are supplied. |
| 5 | Naive timestamps (`'2026-03-08 23:30:00'`, no offset) are treated as **UTC** and shifted to Moscow time, which gives `09.03.2026 02:30`. `endOfD('month')` returns `01.04.2026` in MSK. | Send timestamps with an offset (`…T23:30:00+03:00`) or as plain dates. |
| 6 | `:set` works in Community, even though the docs mark it ENTERPRISE (v5). It enables **grouping without aggregators**. Accumulating a sum with `:set` gives wrong results: the first item is counted twice. | Group with `:set`. Do not sum with it. |
| 7 | Row numbering: `{d.list[i].field:print(.i):add(1)}` gives 1..N. `.i` stays 0-based after a filter, so the numbers skip. | Documented workaround. |

## 1. Basics and tables

| Feature | Syntax | Data | Output | Status | Docs | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Substitution | `{d.name}` | `{"name":"Иван"}` | `Иван` | ✅ | …/substitutions/the-basics.html | Since v0 |
| Nested object | `{d.client.address.city}` | `…{"city":"Москва"}` | `Москва` | ✅ | same | |
| Missing field | `{d.missing}` | `{}` | *(empty)* | ✅ | same | No error is raised, only an empty string |
| Array by index | `{d.items[0].name} {d.items[1].name}` | 2 items | `a b` | ✅ | same | 0-based |
| Array search | `{d.items[id=2].name}`, `{d.items[code='X'].name}` | | `b` | ✅ | …/substitutions/array-search.html | |
| Parent `..` | `{d.client.sub..name}` | | `Родитель` | ✅ | the-basics | |
| XML special chars | literal `<&> "…"` and data `<b>&"'` | | printed as is, escaped correctly | ✅ | | |
| Complement `c.` | `{c.param} {c.org.name}` | body `complement: {param:'X', org:{name:'ООО Ромашка'}}` | `X ООО Ромашка` | ✅ | the-basics | The `complement` key must be in the render body. Our client.ts does **not** pass it today. |
| Current date | `{c.now:formatD('DD.MM.YYYY')}` | | today's date | ✅ | …/formatters/date.html | UTC moment, displayed in the timezone option |
| Alias | `{#cl = d.client}{$cl.name}` | | `Пётр` | ✅ | …/substitutions/aliases.html | v2+ |
| Parametrized alias | `{#byId($x) = d.items[id=$x]}{$byId(2).name}` | | `b` | ✅ | aliases | |
| Option tag | `{o.preReleaseFeatureIn=5002000}`, `{o.useHighPrecisionArithmetic=true}` | | tag removed, option applied | ✅ | …/computation/simple-mathematics.html | |
| **Table row repetition** | row 1: `{d.cars[i].brand}` · `{d.cars[i].qty}`; row 2: `{d.cars[i+1].brand}` | 4 cars | 4 rows: `Лада 3`, `Тесла 1`, `Лада 2`, `БМВ 5` | ✅ | …/repetitions/with-arrays.html | The `[i+1]` row is removed |
| Paragraph repetition | paragraph `{d.cars[i].brand}`, then paragraph `{d.cars[i+1].brand}` | | 4 paragraphs | ✅ | same | |
| Inline repetition | `{d.cars[i].brand}, {d.cars[i+1].brand}` in one paragraph | | `Лада, Тесла, Лада, БМВ, ` | ⚠️ | same | Trailing separator is kept |
| Root array | `{d[i].brand}` / `{d[i+1].brand}` | data is an array | 4 lines | ✅ | same | |
| **Nested repetition (paragraphs)** | `{d.groups[i].name}` / `- {d.groups[i].items[i].x}` / `- {d.groups[i].items[i+1].x}` / `{d.groups[i+1].name}` | 3 groups, the last one empty | `Г1 - a - b Г2 - c Г3` | ✅ | same | An empty inner array produces no rows |
| **Nested repetition (table rows)** | same tags, one per row | | `[Г1][ a][ b][Г2][ c][Г3]` | ✅ | same | |
| Table inside a paragraph loop | paragraph `{d.groups[i].name}`, table with `items[i]/[i+1]`, paragraph `{d.groups[i+1].name}` | | one table per group | ✅ | same | |
| Horizontal loop (columns) | cells `{d.cols[i].n}` and `{d.cols[i+1].n}` in the same row, on every row | 3 cols | `[A|B|C] [1|2|3]` | ✅ | same | `[i+1]` is required on each row |
| Loop over object keys | `{d.obj[i].att}={d.obj[i].val}` | `{"a":1,"b":2}` | `a=1`, `b=2` | ✅ | …/repetitions/with-objects.html | v3+ |
| Loop over string array | `{d.tags[i]}` / `{d.tags[i+1]}` | `["x","y"]` | `x`, `y` | ✅ | with-arrays | v4.9+ |
| Parent access in a loop | `{d.items[i]..title}` | | value repeated in each row | ✅ | | |
| **Row numbering** | `{d.cars[i].brand:print(.i):add(1)}` | | `1,2,3,4` | ✅ (workaround) | with-arrays (iterator `.i`, v4+) | `{d.cars[i].i}` prints nothing. `print(.i)` is 0-based. |
| Row numbering, documented way | `{d.cars[i].brand:count()}` | | **error**: `Formatter "cumCount" is disabled in the Community Edition` | ❌ | …/formatters/array.html | `count()` becomes `cumCount` |
| Numbering with a filter | `[i, ok=true]` + `print(.i):add(1)` | | `1, 3, 4` | ⚠️ | | `.i` is the original index. Put the row number in the data instead. |
| **Empty array** | table with header, `[i]` row and `[i+1]` row | `{"cars":[]}` (or the key missing) | only the header row remains | ✅ | with-arrays | No error |

| Multiline text | `{d.text:convCRLF}` | `"строка1\nстрока2"` | a `<w:br/>` line break | ✅ | …/formatters/text.html | Without `convCRLF`, the raw `\n` stays inside `w:t` and Word shows a space |
| Missing `[i+1]` | `{d.cars[i].brand}` only | | error `The marker … has no corresponding [i+1]` | ❌ (template error) | | Clear error message |
| Unknown formatter | `{d.n:fooBar()}` | | error `Formatter "fooBar" does not exist. Do you mean "mod"?` | ❌ (template error) | | |
| Unclosed tag | `{d.n` | | printed literally as `{d.n` | ⚠️ | | No error |

## 2. Formatting

Production lang is `ru-ru`. For numbers and currency, compare the `lang: 'ru'` column.

### Dates (`formatD` and related, v3+; `diffD` v4.4+; `formatI` v4.1+). Docs: …/formatters/date.html, …/formatters/interval.html

| Syntax | Input | Output (ru-ru, Europe/Moscow) | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `formatD('DD MMMM YYYY')` | `2026-03-08` | `08 марта 2026` | ✅ | Genitive case is correct |
| `formatD('D MMMM YYYY г.')` | same | `8 марта 2026 г.` | ✅ | |
| `formatD('MMMM YYYY')` | same | `март 2026` | ✅ | Nominative when there is no day |
| `formatD('DD.MM.YYYY')` / `formatD('L')` | same | `08.03.2026` | ✅ | |
| `formatD('LL')` | same | `8 марта 2026 г.` | ✅ | |
| `formatD('LLLL')` | `2026-03-08T10:00:00Z` | `воскресенье, 8 марта 2026 г., 13:00` | ✅ | Converted to MSK |
| `formatD('dddd, D MMM')` | `2026-03-08` | `воскресенье, 8 мар.` | ✅ | |
| `formatD('DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm')` | `2026-03-08T22:30:00Z` | `09.03.2026 01:30` | ✅ | |
| same | `2026-03-08 23:30:00` (no offset) | `09.03.2026 02:30` | ⚠️ | **A naive timestamp is treated as UTC** |
| same | `2026-03-08T23:30:00+03:00` | `08.03.2026 23:30` | ✅ | Send timestamps with an offset |
| same, render option `timezone:'UTC'` | `…T22:30:00Z` | `08.03.2026 22:30` | ✅ | |
| `formatD('DD.MM.YYYY','YYYYMMDD')` | `20260308` | `08.03.2026` | ✅ | Custom input pattern |
| `formatD('DD.MM.YYYY','X')` | `1772928000` | `08.03.2026` | ✅ | Unix seconds |
| `formatD(...)` | `null` | *(empty)* | ✅ | |
| `formatD(...)` | `"не дата"` | `Invalid Date` | ⚠️ | Printed into the document |
| `addD(1,'month')` | `2026-01-31` | `28.02.2026` | ✅ | |
| `subD(7,'day')` | `2026-03-08` | `01.03.2026` | ✅ | |
| `startOfD('month')` | `2026-03-08` | `01.03.2026` | ✅ | |
| `endOfD('month')` | `2026-03-08` | `01.04.2026` (MSK) / `31.03.2026 23:59` (timezone UTC) | ⚠️ | Computed in UTC, then shifted to MSK. Do not use it with Moscow tz. |
| `diffD('2026-12-31','days')` | `2026-03-08` | `298` | ✅ | |
| `convDate('YYYY-MM-DD','DD.MM.YYYY')` | `2026-03-08` | `08.03.2026` | ✅ | Deprecated |
| `formatI('human')` / `formatI('human+')` | `7200000` | `2 часа` / `через 2 часа` | ✅ | Russian output |
| `formatI('days','hours')` | `48` | `2` | ✅ | |

### Numbers (v1.2+; `mod` v4.5.2, `abs` v4.12, `ceil`/`floor` v4.22.8). Docs: …/formatters/number.html, …/computation/simple-mathematics.html

| Syntax | Input | Output ru-ru (prod) | Output `lang:'ru'` | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `formatN()` | `1234567.891` | `1,234,567.891` | `1 234 567,891` | ⚠️ ru-ru = English format |
| `formatN(2)` | `1234567.891` | `1,234,567.89` | `1 234 567,89` | ⚠️ ditto. The separator with `ru` is a **regular space** (U+0020, not NBSP), so a number can wrap across lines. |
| `formatN(0)` | `1234567.5` | `1,234,568` | `1 234 568` | ⚠️ |
| `formatN(2)` on a string | `"1234.5"` | `1,234.50` | | ✅ Numeric strings are accepted |
| `formatN(2)` | `null` | *(empty)* | | ✅ |
| `round(2)` | `10.055` | `10.06` | | ✅ Output uses a dot, not localized |
| `add(2)` / `sub(.b)` / `mul(.b)` / `div(3)` | | `1002.4` / `7` / `30` / `3.33…` | | ✅ `.field` refers to a sibling field |
| `add(.b * 2 - 1)` | `10`, b=3 | `15` | | ✅ Expressions support `+ - * /` with no parentheses |
| `div(0)` | `10` | `10` | | ⚠️ Division by zero silently returns the input |
| `mod(3)`, `abs()`, `ceil()`, `floor()`, `toFixed(2)` | | `1`, `5.5`, `11`, `10`, `10.10` | | ✅ |
| `0.1 + 0.2` via `add(.b)` | | `0.30000000000000004` | | ⚠️ Chain `formatN`/`round` |
| `{o.useHighPrecisionArithmetic=true}` + `add(.b)` | | `0.3` | | ✅ v4.22.4+ |

### Currency (v1.2+). Docs: …/formatters/currency.html

| Syntax | Input | ru-ru (prod) | `lang:'ru'` | Status / note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `formatC()` | `1234567.891` | `1,234,567.89 €` | `1 234 567,89 ₽` | ⚠️ ru-ru gives **€** with English separators |
| `formatC(0)` | `1234.5` | `1,235 €` | `1 235 ₽` | ⚠️ |
| `formatC('M')` | `1` / `2` | `5.00 €` (ignored) | `rouble` / `roubles` | ⚠️ The currency name is always in English |
| `formatC('LL')` | `2` | `5.00 €` | `2,00 roubles` | ⚠️ English |
| ru-ru + `currencySource:'RUB', currencyTarget:'RUB'` | `1000` | `1,000.00 ₽` | | ⚠️ Symbol fixed, separators still English |
| `formatC(2,'RUB')` | `1000` | | `1 000,00 ₽` | ✅ |
| `formatC(2,'USD')` without rates | `1000` | `1,140.30 $` | `14,68 $` | ⚠️ **Silently converts with built-in rates** (source = locale currency) |
| `convCurr('USD')` without rates | `1000` | `1140.3000000000002` | `14.679643146796433` | ⚠️ same |
| body `currencySource:'RUB', currencyTarget:'RUB', currencyRates:{RUB:1, USD:0.011}` + `formatC(2,'USD')` / `convCurr('USD')` | `1000` | | `11,00 $` / `11` | ✅ Correct only with explicit rates |
| body `currency:{source,target,rates}` (the docs' wording) | | ignored | | ⚠️ The HTTP API keys are `currencySource`, `currencyTarget` and `currencyRates` |

### Text (versions per docs: case/print v0.12–0.13; padl/padr v3; split/ellipsis/prepend/append/replace v4.12; substr v4.18; printJSON v4.23; t v4.23.2). Docs: …/formatters/text.html

| Syntax | Input | Output | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lowerCase()` / `upperCase()` | `ПРИВЕТ Мир` / `привет ёж` | `привет мир` / `ПРИВЕТ ЁЖ` | ✅ | Cyrillic is fine |
| `ucFirst()` / `ucWords()` | `иванов иван` | `Иванов иван` / `Иванов Иван` | ✅ | |
| `substr(0,5)` | `Длинная строка` | `Длинн` | ✅ | |
| `substr(0,10,true)` | `Длинная строка текста` | `Длинная ` | ✅ | Word mode keeps a trailing space |
| `padl(6,'0')` / `padr(6,'.')` | `42` / `ab` | `000042` / `ab....` | ✅ | |
| `ellipsis(7)` | `Длинная строка` | `Длинная...` | ✅ | |
| `prepend('№ ')` / `append(' руб.')` | `15` | `№ 15` / `15 руб.` | ✅ | |
| `replace('-','/')` | `2026-03-08` | `2026/03/08` | ✅ | |
| `len()` | `Привет` / `[1,2,3]` | `6` / `3` | ✅ | `{d.arr.length}` also works |
| `print('X')` | any | `X` | ✅ | |
| `unaccent()` | `café ёлка` | `cafe елка` | ⚠️ | Also turns **ё into е** |
| `printJSON()` | `{"a":1}` | `{"a":1}` | ✅ | |
| `split(',')` | `a,b` | `a,b` | ⚠️ | Has no visible effect on its own |
| Chaining | `lowerCase:upperCase:prepend('<'):append('>')` | `<АБ>` | ✅ | |
| `formatR()` | `RU` | error: disabled in Community | ❌ | |
| `defaultURL('…')` | | error: disabled in Community | ❌ | |

### Arrays. Docs: …/formatters/array.html

| Syntax | Input | Output | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arrayJoin()` | `["a","b","c"]` | `a, b, c` | ✅ v4.12 |
| `arrayJoin('; ',1,1)` | same | `b` | ✅ |
| `arrayMap(', ', ':', 'name')` | `[{name:a},{name:b}]` | `a, b` | ✅ v0.12.5 |
| `count()` | in a loop | error (it becomes `cumCount`) | ❌ |

## 3. Conditions, filters, sorting, translations

Docs: …/conditions/overview.html, …/conditions/inline-conditions.html, …/conditions/conditional-blocks.html, …/conditions/smart-conditions.html, …/repetitions/filtering.html, …/repetitions/sorting.html, …/repetitions/distinct.html, …/advanced-features/translations-i18n.html

| Feature | Syntax | Data | Output | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ifEQ + show/elseShow | `{d.v:ifEQ('paid'):show('Оплачен'):elseShow('Не оплачен')}` | `paid` / `new` | `Оплачен` / `Не оплачен` | ✅ | v3+ |
| show without elseShow | `{d.v:ifEQ(1):show('один')}` | `2` | `2` | ⚠️ | When false, the **original value is printed**. Add `elseShow('')`. |
| ifNE, ifGT, ifGTE, ifLT, ifLTE | e.g. `ifGT(100):show('>100'):elseShow('<=100')` | | as expected | ✅ | |
| ifIN / ifNIN | `ifIN('Лада')` on an array or a string | | `есть` / `нет X` | ✅ | On a string it is a substring test |
| ifEM / ifNEM | `ifEM():show('пусто'):elseShow('не пусто')` | `''`, `null`, `[]` | `пусто` | ✅ | |
| ifTE | `ifTE('number')` | `5` | `число` | ✅ | v4.4+ |
| and / or | `{d.v:ifGT(0):and(.b):ifEQ(3):show('оба')}`; `…:or(.b):ifEQ(3)…` | | correct | ✅ | |
| Boolean | `ifEQ(true)`; `ifEQ('true')` | `true` | `да` for both | ✅ | |
| Dynamic param / output | `ifEQ(.b)`, `elseShow(.v)` | | correct | ✅ | |
| **Default value** | `{d.field:ifEmpty('—')}` | `null`, `''`, `[]`, missing field, missing nested object | `—` | ✅ | `0` stays `0` |
| ifEmpty + formatter order | `{d.v:formatD('DD.MM.YYYY'):ifEmpty('—')}` → `—`; `{d.v:ifEmpty('—'):formatD(...)}` → `Invalid Date` | `null` | | ⚠️ | **Put ifEmpty last**. `formatN(2):ifEmpty('—')` → `—` ✅ |
| showBegin/showEnd (inline) | `A{d.f:ifEQ(true):showBegin}B{d.f:showEnd}C` | `true` / `false` | `ABC` / `AC` | ✅ | v2+ |
| hideBegin/hideEnd (paragraphs) | the tags in their own paragraphs around a block | `true` | block and tag paragraphs removed | ✅ | |
| **Conditional row hiding** via hideBegin/hideEnd inside a row | `{d.cars[i].ok:ifEQ(false):hideBegin}` in the first cell, `…hideEnd}` in the last cell | | the row is replaced by a **1-cell empty row** | ⚠️ broken | The table structure is damaged |
| showBegin/showEnd across static rows | | `false` | an empty 1-cell row remains, and the next row loses its `tcPr` | ⚠️ broken | |
| **Conditional row hiding: the recommended way** | `{d.cars[i, ok=true].brand}` … `{d.cars[i+1, ok=true].brand}` | | rows with `ok=false` are not rendered | ✅ | Use a loop filter |
| drop / keep (smart conditions) | `{d.f:ifEQ(true):drop(p)}`, `drop(row)`, `drop(table)`, `keep(p)` | | **error** `Formatter "drop" is disabled in the Community Edition` | ❌ | Docs: ENTERPRISE, v4+ |
| Filter: number | `[i, qty > 1]` | | `Лада Лада БМВ` | ✅ | |
| Filter: in `[i+1]` only once | `{d.cars[i, qty > 1].brand}` + `{d.cars[i+1].brand}` | | same result | ✅ | v5 behavior |
| Filter: string | `[i, brand='Лада']` or `[i, brand=Лада]` | | `3`, `2` | ✅ | Quotes optional |
| Filter: boolean | `[i, ok=true]` | | correct | ✅ | |
| Filter: AND | `[i, qty > 1, qty < 5]` | | `Лада Лада` | ✅ | There is no OR. Precompute a flag in the data. |
| Filter: by index | `[i, i < 2]`, `[i, i!=-1]` (exclude last) | | correct | ✅ | |
| Sort ascending | `{d.cars[qty, i].brand}` / `{d.cars[qty+1, i+1].brand}` | | `Тесла Лада Лада БМВ` | ✅ | v2+ |
| Multi-sort | `[brand, qty, i]` | | `БМВ5 Лада2 Лада3 Тесла1` | ✅ | |
| Sort descending | `[-qty, i]` | | original order | ⚠️ silently ignored | Docs: "coming soon". Sort in SQL. |
| Distinct | `{d.cars[brand].brand}` / `{d.cars[brand+1].brand}` | | `БМВ Лада Тесла` | ✅ | Output is sorted by the key |
| Translations `{t()}` | `{t(Итого)}` + `{d.v:t}` | body `translations: {'ru-ru': {...}}` | `Total: яблоко` | ✅ | Key = the exact `lang` value. With `lang:'ru'` it must be `translations.ru`. |
| Missing translation | `{t(Итого)}` | | `Итого` | ✅ | Falls back to the key |
| t() inside show | `ifEQ(1):show({t(hello)})` | | translated | ✅ | |

## 4. Totals and grouping

Docs: …/computation/aggregation.html (v4.0+; listed as available for Cloud/On-prem/Embedded, **not** marked Enterprise), …/repetitions/grouping.html, …/computation/store-and-transform.html

| Feature | Syntax | Output on our Carbone | Status | Note / workaround |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| aggSum | `{d.cars[].qty:aggSum}` | error `Formatter "aggSum" is disabled in the Community Edition` | ❌ | Also fails with filter, nested arrays, `mul(.price):aggSum`, partition `aggSum(.brand)`, or inside a loop |
| aggAvg, aggMin, aggMax, aggCount, aggCountD, aggStr, aggStrD | `{d.cars[].qty:aggAvg}` … | same error | ❌ | |
| cumSum, cumCount, cumCountD | `{d.cars[i].qty:cumSum}` | same error | ❌ | |
| Sum, workaround | put `"total": 11` (or `items_total`) into the JSON/SQL and use `{d.total:formatN(2)}` | ✅ | ✅ | **Recommended**: compute in the data source |
| Sum via `:set` accumulator | `{d.cars[].qty:add(c.total):set(c.total)}{c.total}` | `14`, expected `11`. A 1-item test with 7 gives `14`. | ❌ wrong | The first element is counted twice. Do not use. |
| Count, workaround | `{d.cars:len()}` or `{d.cars.length}` | `4` | ✅ | |
| Group header (distinct) | `{d.cars[brand].brand}` / `{d.cars[brand+1].brand}` | `БМВ`, `Лада`, `Тесла` | ✅ | Gives no subtotals or details |
| **Grouping with detail rows** | `{d.cars[]:set(c.g[id=.brand].rows[])}` then `{c.g[i].id}` / `{c.g[i].rows[i].qty}` / `{c.g[i].rows[i+1].qty}` / `{c.g[i+1].id}` | `Лада: 3, 2 · Тесла: 1 · БМВ: 5` (paragraphs and table rows) | ✅ (surprise) | `:set` is documented as ENTERPRISE v5 but works in Community. Order of first appearance is kept. The `:set` tag prints nothing. Set the **whole object** (`d.cars[]:set(...rows[])`); setting fields one by one creates separate half-empty items. |
| Group subtotal via `:set` | `…add(c.g[id=.brand].sum):set(c.g[id=.brand].sum)` | error `Forbidden array access` | ❌ | Put subtotals in pre-grouped JSON |
| Pre-grouped JSON | `{d.groups[i].name}` + nested `items[i]` + `{d.groups[i].subtotal}` | ✅ (nested loops tested) | ✅ | **Recommended** for subtotals: build `groups[{name, subtotal, items[]}]` in SQL |

## Recommendations for the admin reference (RU)

1. Totals, counts, subtotals and averages: compute them in SQL and pass them as fields. Aggregators do not work in our edition.
2. Hide a table row: use a loop filter `[i, поле=значение]`. Do not use hideBegin/hideEnd in tables, and do not use drop.
3. Row number: `{d.list[i].любое_поле:print(.i):add(1)}`, or better, add `rownum` in SQL.
4. Default value: `{d.x:ifEmpty('—')}`, always as the **last** formatter.
5. Grouping: pre-grouped JSON (preferred), or `{d.rows[]:set(c.g[id=.key].rows[])}`.
6. Numbers and money: once the API sends `lang:'ru'`, `formatN(2)` gives `1 234,50` and `formatC(2)` gives `1 234,50 ₽`. Do not use `formatC('M'|'LL')` (English names) or a target currency without rates.
7. Dates: `formatD('DD MMMM YYYY')` gives `08 марта 2026`. Timestamps must carry an offset. Avoid `endOfD`.
